text: ここから　にげだそうにも　おなじ　ところに　でてしまう　いわの　かずに　なにか　ヒントが　あるのかな…？

structure.jp: ここから　にげだそうにも
structure.en: even if I try to escape from here

structure.jp: おなじ　ところに　でてしまう
structure.en: I end up coming out in the same place

structure.jp: なにか　ヒントが　あるのかな…？
structure.en: I wonder if there's some hint...?

patterns.name: 〜ようにも
patterns.explanation: The 'let's do' form of a verb plus にも means 'even though I try to do it', followed by why it fails. にげだそうにも = 'even when I try to run out'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing ends up happening, against your wishes. でてしまう = 'I end up coming out'.

patterns.name: 〜のかな
patterns.explanation: のかな at the end shows the speaker wondering to themselves. あるのかな = 'I wonder if there is'.
